description: This file is a shell script used for testing aspects of the 'git svn' integration, specifically focusing on globbing refspecs with prefixed glob patterns, handling of multiple glob patterns, and validation of pattern syntax. It contains multiple tests that set up SVN repositories, perform operations, and verify git-svn behavior regarding glob patterns.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: External method wrapping SVN commands used in tests.

methods.name: poke
methods.description: External method used to modify or touch files during tests to trigger version control changes.
